labels.accept_and_revise: Author accepts the concern and revises.
labels.clarify_without_new_work: Author clarifies existing evidence without new work.
labels.defer_to_future_work: Author acknowledges value but defers to future work.
labels.justify_existing_choice: Author defends or justifies an existing choice.
labels.narrow_claim: Author narrows the claim or scope.
labels.partially_concede: Author accepts part of the concern while preserving part of the original position.
labels.respectfully_disagree: Author explicitly but politely challenges the reviewer premise.
labels.translate_to_editorial_signal: Author frames the response as an editor-readable resolution signal.
